findings.title: 8 eMudhra certificates are compromised. Here's what you need to know
findings.summary_md: On October 19, 2026 at approximately 17:00 UTC, Cloudflare became aware that private keys for eight eMudhra intermediate certificates were compromised. The certificates were widely trusted and could allow an attacker to forge browser- and app-trusted credentials for arbitrary domains.

findings.title: Eight eMudhra CA Keys Compromised, Triggering Emergency Fixes Across Browsers and Software
findings.summary_md: The researcher credited as Wayne demonstrated access by signing messages with each of the eight weak keys and notifying root programs. Apple blocked the certificates on October 19, Microsoft on October 20, and Go released emergency updates blocking them on October 19.

findings.title: eMudhra Certificate Authority Compromise Triggers Emergency Action Across Browsers
findings.summary_md: Researcher Wayne signed a message with each compromised key to prove possession. A disclosure site published by Dennis Jackson provides certificates, public keys, and signatures for independent verification of the eight compromised intermediate CA keys.
